lines.text: Wait! Cheetah vs Falcon: Who Hits 240 MPH in a Race!
Most kids guess totally wrong about fastest animal in the world!
Stop and picture what actually happens inside.
Cheetahs sprint fastest on land around 60-70 mph, while a diving.
peregrine falcon plunges faster than 200 mph (over 240 mph recorded).
Nature uses amazing science tricks right under our noses!
Even many grown-ups still believe the old rumor instead of this fact!
Now you know the real truth behind 240 Mph Winner!
